name: Magic Mushroom (Sweeter)
text:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
Magic mushrooms are the treat that Hoddydoddies are most famous for, as they've made their way into various fairy tales across the planes. While these mushrooms are real, their effects can vary, so those who seek them out should be very careful about what strain they consume. Additionally, consuming more than one magic mushroom within a day causes the user to become Stupefied 3 until their next daily preparations.

A fancy golden mushroom, a sweeter magic mushroom grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks for 10 minutes.
